text: Unlike Swift-3, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Ibis-9 is March 18, 2029. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Ibis-9 applies to Swift-3, the retirement date differs.
The rate limit of Godwit-3 is 2950 requests per minute; callers over it get a 429. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Unlike Lark-5, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Merlin-8 is the Oslo datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Merlin-8 applies to Lark-5, the datacenter differs.

Unlike Curlew-5, whose retirement date is handled elsewhere, the retirement date of Swift-3 is June 13, 2028. Nobody should assume the retirement date of Swift-3 applies to Curlew-5, the retirement date differs. The page was last reviewed in the spring.
Unlike Merlin-8, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Curlew-5 is OCaml. Nobody should assume the language of Curlew-5 applies to Merlin-8, the language differs.
Unlike Ibis-9, whose datacenter is handled elsewhere, the datacenter of Curlew-5 is the Bergen datacenter. Nobody should assume the datacenter of Curlew-5 applies to Ibis-9, the datacenter differs.
Unlike Ibis-9, whose language is handled elsewhere, the language of Godwit-3 is Elixir. Nobody should assume the language of Godwit-3 applies to Ibis-9, the language differs.
The service Godwit-3 takes traffic on port 2557, and the port is fixed across every environment. Nothing about this has been disputed so far.
Ibis-9 was granted a budget of $2850k this year; an unspent budget does not roll over.

Unlike Swift-3, whose rate limit is handled elsewhere, the rate limit of Merlin-8 is 1200 requests per minute. Nobody should assume the rate limit of Merlin-8 applies to Swift-3, the rate limit differs. An older draft of this note was archived.
The pager rotation for Godwit-3 is run by Umar Zielinski; alerts page them first. Details change slowly, so check the history first.

All instances of Swift-3 live in the datacenter at Nairobi.
Swift-3 listens on port 2817; anyone who cannot reach that port should check the firewall rules.
